title: A first-order hyperbolic reformulation of the Cahn-Hilliard equation
journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society A: Mathematical, Physical and Engineering Sciences

license_or_terms.repository_policy: The upstream TeX archive was inspected temporarily and is not redistributed in this repository; no open-reuse right for the publisher PDF is assumed.

preprocessing_note: Downloaded the arXiv v1 TeX source to a temporary directory, computed SHA-256, inspected Cahn-Hilliard.tex, and transcribed only the mathematical system, energy, characteristic speeds, and stated asymptotic scaling into a repository-owned formula evaluator. The upstream archive and publisher PDF are not repository inputs.

formula_locators.source_locator: arXiv TeX label eq:CH1; journal equation (1.1)
arXiv TeX label eq:CH_Hyp; journal section 2(b), equations (2.5a-e)
arXiv TeX subsection 'Lyapunov functional', labels eq:Edecay and eq:Edecay_int; journal section 2(c)
arXiv TeX remark following eq:CH_Hyp: alpha=gamma^-1, tau=gamma^2, beta=gamma^2

unit_system: source equations are nondimensional/model coefficients; UET implementation accepts normalized units only
known_access_limitations: Publisher PDF endpoint required a JavaScript/cookie challenge during the 2026-07-22 audit.
Formula transcription was checked against arXiv v1 TeX; journal metadata was checked through DOI metadata, but the publisher PDF was not stored or parsed.
claim_boundary: The source supports an external first-order hyperbolic Cahn-Hilliard comparator.
It does not derive the UET matter-space equations, identify its auxiliary phase with UET space response, or establish a uniformly subluminal parabolic limit.
